## 1. LAUNCH — Splash, Boot & Version Check

> Source: `uxui.criticalFlows` (Flow 1), design-spec.md §1A (M-01, M-02), `appStore.forceUpgrade`.

### LAUNCH-01 — Normal cold-start, version OK

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Installed app version ≥ server `minimumVersion`; user has an active session. |
| **Action** | Cold-launch the app. |
| **Expected** | M-01 (Splash) displays briefly. `GET /v1/version/minimum` returns OK. App transitions directly to M-11 (Level map) without presenting sign-in. |

### LAUNCH-02 — Cold-start, version check network failure

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Device has no internet. No cached force-upgrade state. |
| **Action** | Cold-launch the app. |
| **Expected** | M-01 Splash times out the version check. App opens to normal flow (welcome or level map) using cached session. A silent retry is queued for next API call. The app does **not** crash or dead-end. |

### LAUNCH-03 — Version check returns upgrade required (see UPGRADE section)

Covered by UPGRADE-01 through UPGRADE-03.

## 2. AUTH — Registration, Age Gate & Sign-In (Google, Apple, Phone)

> Source: `qa.mustNotBreak` ("Sign-up and sign-in (Google, Apple, phone)"), design-spec.md §§1B, §3, §10 (M-03–M-08, M-10), `security.authMethod`, `security.socialLogin`.

### AUTH-01 — New user sign-up via Google, age ≥ 13

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Fresh install, no account. |
| **Action** | Tap "Continue with Google" on M-03. Complete Google OAuth. Enter display name and age = 18 when prompted. Accept Privacy Policy & ToS on M-08. |
| **Expected** | Account is created server-side with `auth_provider = google`. App lands on M-11 (Level map). No parental consent screens (M-06 series) are shown. |

### AUTH-02 — New user sign-up via Sign in with Apple, age ≥ 13 (iOS)

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Fresh install on iOS, no account. |
| **Action** | Tap "Continue with Apple" on M-03. Complete Apple OAuth. Enter display name and age = 16. Accept M-08. |
| **Expected** | Account created with `auth_provider = apple`. App lands on M-11. No VPC screens shown. |

### AUTH-03 — New user sign-up via phone, age ≥ 13

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Fresh install, no account. |
| **Action** | Tap "Continue with phone number" on M-03. Enter valid mobile, display name, age = 14 on M-04. Accept M-08. |
| **Expected** | Account created with phone credentials. App lands on M-11. No VPC screens shown. No SMS OTP is sent or requested. |

### AUTH-04 — Age gate boundary: age = 12 triggers VPC routing 🛡

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Fresh install; any auth path (test at least phone and Google). |
| **Action** | Enter age = 12 during profile capture. |
| **Expected** | Silent age routing (M-05) sends user to M-06 (Parent gate). Account remains `pending_parental_consent` until VPC completes (see VPC section). |

### AUTH-05 — Age gate boundary: age = 13 skips VPC

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Fresh install. |
| **Action** | Enter age = 13 during profile capture. |
| **Expected** | VPC path is **not** triggered. Flow proceeds directly to M-08. |

### AUTH-06 — Phone sign-up form validation: missing fields

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | On M-04 (phone path). |
| **Action** | Submit with one field empty (mobile, name, age — test each individually). |
| **Expected** | Submission blocked; inline field error shown. App stays on M-04. |

### AUTH-07 — Phone sign-up form validation: invalid mobile number

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | On M-04. |
| **Action** | Enter a non-numeric or too-short mobile number and submit. |
| **Expected** | Inline validation error on mobile field. Submission blocked. |

### AUTH-08 — Returning user sign-in via Google

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Existing Google-linked account; signed out. |
| **Action** | Open app → M-10 → "Continue with Google" → complete OAuth. |
| **Expected** | User authenticated and lands on M-11 with progress restored. No OTP or extra verification. |

### AUTH-09 — Returning user sign-in via Apple on new device (iOS)

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Existing Apple-linked account; fresh install on a different iOS device. |
| **Action** | M-10 → "Continue with Apple" → complete OAuth. |
| **Expected** | Account and progress restored automatically. Lands on M-11. |

### AUTH-10 — Returning user sign-in via phone (same device, no OTP)

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Existing phone-only account; same device; signed out. |
| **Action** | M-10 → "Sign in with phone number" → enter registered mobile + matching name. |
| **Expected** | User authenticated without SMS OTP and lands on M-11. |

### AUTH-11 — Phone sign-in on new device (no OTP — weak recovery)

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Existing phone-only account; fresh install on new device. |
| **Action** | M-10 → enter registered mobile + name. |
| **Expected** | If mobile + name match, session established on M-11. If mismatch, inline error with "Contact support" link to M-31. No SMS OTP flow exists. |

### AUTH-12 — Session persistence across app backgrounding and relaunch

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Logged-in user. |
| **Action** | Background the app and relaunch. |
| **Expected** | User resumes session directly on M-11 (no re-authentication). Consistent with `security.sessionManagement`. |

### AUTH-13 — Privacy Policy and ToS must be accepted before account activation

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | New user reaches M-08 (Privacy & ToS acknowledgment). |
| **Action** | Attempt to bypass M-08 via navigation or direct API call. |
| **Expected** | Account is not activated and app does not advance to M-11 until M-08 is completed. Backend validates consent flag. |

### AUTH-14 — Sign in with Apple shown on iOS when Google is offered

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | iOS device; M-03 or M-10. |
| **Action** | Observe auth button layout. |
| **Expected** | Both "Continue with Google" and "Continue with Apple" buttons are visible with equal prominence (App Store policy). |

### AUTH-15 — Sign in with Apple hidden on Android

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Android device; M-03 or M-10. |
| **Action** | Observe auth button layout. |
| **Expected** | Google and phone options shown. Apple button is not displayed. |

### AUTH-16 — Phone sign-up rate limits abuse vector

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Same IP and same generated app install ID. |
| **Action** | Attempt to create more than 5 phone-path accounts from the install in one day, and more than 20 from the same IP. |
| **Expected** | API returns 429 after configured thresholds. No extra accounts created. UI shows a generic "Try again later" error. No SMS OTP is introduced. |

## 3. VPC — Verifiable Parental Consent (Path A & Path B)

> Source: design-spec.md §11, `security.parentalConsent`, screens M-06–M-06F, M-07. A child checkbox alone is **not** sufficient — these tests verify the concrete VPC mechanism.

### VPC-01 — Path A: full under-13 onboarding (Google child sign-up) 🛡

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Fresh install; child signs up with Google; age = 10. |
| **Action** | Complete M-06 (Parent gate) → M-06A (parent Google OAuth, **different account from child's**) → M-06B (attestation: name, relationship, consent checkboxes) → M-06C (child profile confirm) → M-07 (child notice) → M-08. |
| **Expected** | `ParentalConsentRecord` created with `method = oauth_parent_attestation`, `status = verified`. `accountStatus` transitions to `consented`. App reaches M-11. |

### VPC-02 — Path A: parent OAuth must use a separate adult account 🛡

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Under-13 onboarding on M-06A. |
| **Action** | Attempt to complete parent OAuth using the **same Google/Apple account** the child just used. |
| **Expected** | Backend rejects or UI forces account picker / "Use another account." Child OAuth credentials cannot satisfy parental consent. |

### VPC-03 — Path A: attestation form blocks submit until all fields complete 🛡

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Parent on M-06B after successful M-06A. |
| **Action** | Attempt submit with missing guardian name, unchecked consent boxes, or missing relationship. |
| **Expected** | Submit blocked with inline errors. No `ParentalConsentRecord` created until all required fields are valid. Privacy Policy link opens in-app browser. |

### VPC-04 — Path B: full under-13 phone sign-up flow 🛡

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Fresh install; phone path; age = 8. |
| **Action** | M-04 → M-06 → M-06D (parent email) → M-06E (waiting). Parent opens email link on their device → completes M-06F web confirmation → returns to app. |
| **Expected** | `ParentalConsentRecord` with `method = email_plus_confirmation`, `status = verified`. App proceeds M-07 → M-08 → M-11. Verification token is single-use. |

### VPC-05 — Path B: resend email respects 60s cooldown 🛡

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | On M-06E; verification email already sent. |
| **Action** | Tap "Resend email" before 60 seconds elapse; wait 60s and tap again. |
| **Expected** | Resend disabled (or countdown shown) until cooldown expires. Second send generates a new token; previous token is invalidated. |

### VPC-06 — Path B: expired verification token (72h) 🛡

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Path B email sent; simulate token age > 72 hours. |
| **Action** | Parent opens expired link on M-06F web page. |
| **Expected** | Web page shows expiry message. `accountStatus` remains `pending_parental_consent` (or moves to `consent_expired`). App on M-06E shows restart-VPC prompt. No account activation. |

### VPC-06A — Path B abandoned account cleanup after 14 days 🛡

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Under-13 phone-path account is `pending_parental_consent`; parent never clicks email link; simulate 14 days elapsed. |
| **Action** | Run scheduled cleanup job. |
| **Expected** | Pending child PII and token data are deleted/anonymized. No gameplay access was ever granted. Non-PII audit event remains. |

### VPC-07 — Path B waiting screen: switch to Path A 🛡

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | On M-06E awaiting email verification. |
| **Action** | Tap "Use Google/Apple instead." |
| **Expected** | Navigates to M-06A. Path A can complete consent without waiting for email. Email token invalidated if a new Path B request is not yet sent. |

### VPC-08 — Pending consent state blocks gameplay, ads, and PII analytics 🛡

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Under-13 account in `pending_parental_consent` (VPC incomplete). |
| **Action** | Attempt to reach M-11 via deep link, back navigation, or direct API calls for gameplay, ads, leaderboard, analytics. |
| **Expected** | All blocked server-side. No levels playable. No ad requests. No PII-linked analytics events emitted. User remains on VPC screens. |

### VPC-09 — Parent gate cannot be bypassed 🛡

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Under-13 user on M-06. |
| **Action** | Attempt back button, swipe navigation, deep link to M-11, or unauthenticated API call to create/activate account. |
| **Expected** | Navigation blocked. Account not activated until VPC completes and M-07 is acknowledged. |

### VPC-10 — Child privacy notice (M-07) required after VPC 🛡

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | VPC verified (either path); user on M-07. |
| **Action** | Attempt to proceed without tapping "I understand." |
| **Expected** | Cannot advance to M-08. `child_notice_acknowledged_at` not set until explicit acknowledgment. |

### VPC-11 — ParentalConsentRecord stored correctly for Path A 🛡

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Path A VPC completed. |
| **Action** | Query backend or admin A-08/A-09 for the user record. |
| **Expected** | Record contains: `method`, `parent_oauth_provider`, `parent_oauth_sub`, `parent_email` (from token), `parent_guardian_name`, `parent_relationship`, `consent_policy_version`, `consented_at`. `parentalConsentStatus = consented`. |

### VPC-12 — ParentalConsentRecord stored correctly for Path B 🛡

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Path B VPC completed via web confirmation. |
| **Action** | Query backend or admin for the user record. |
| **Expected** | Record contains: `method = email_plus_confirmation`, `parent_email`, `parent_guardian_name`, `consented_at`, `verification_token_hash` marked consumed. |

### VPC-13 — Parent declines consent on web (M-06F) 🛡

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Valid Path B email link opened on M-06F web page. |
| **Action** | Parent taps decline / closes without consenting. |
| **Expected** | `accountStatus = consent_denied`. App remains blocked. No gameplay access. Audit event logged. |

### VPC-14 — Transactional email provider failure (Path B) 🛡

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Simulate SendGrid/Resend/SES returning an error on M-06D submit. |
| **Action** | Parent enters email and taps send. |
| **Expected** | Inline error: unable to send verification email. Retry option shown. Account stays `pending_parental_consent`. App does not crash. |

### VPC-15 — Under-13 Google sign-up still requires full VPC (child OAuth ≠ parent consent) 🛡

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Child completes Google OAuth with age = 11. |
| **Action** | Observe post-OAuth routing. |
| **Expected** | M-06 Parent gate shown. Child's Google login alone does **not** activate account or skip VPC. |

### VPC-16 — Consent status polling on M-06E

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | App on M-06E; parent has not yet confirmed. |
| **Action** | Observe network calls; parent completes M-06F on web. |
| **Expected** | App polls `GET /v1/consent/status` every ~5s. On `verified`, auto-advances to M-07 without manual refresh. |

## 4. GAMEPLAY — Level Map, Play Loop, Timer & Wrong-Answer Rules

> Source: `qa.mustNotBreak` ("level map navigation; completing a level; level restart on wrong answer; timer scaling by difficulty"), design-spec.md §§1C–1D (M-11–M-16), Flow 3.

### GAMEPLAY-01 — Level map loads and displays correct lock state

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | User has no IAP purchase; has completed levels 1–5. |
| **Action** | Navigate to M-11. |
| **Expected** | Levels 1–5 show as unlocked (free tier). Levels 1–3 show as completed. Level 4 highlighted as current. Levels 6–100 show IAP-locked badge. |

### GAMEPLAY-02 — Start a level and complete it 10/10 under timer

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | User on M-11; level 1 unlocked. |
| **Action** | Tap level 1 → M-12 pre-level card → "Play" → answer all 10 questions correctly before timer expires. |
| **Expected** | M-14 (Level complete) is displayed with a celebration animation and a "Next level" CTA. Level 1 is marked completed on M-11. Analytics event `level_completed` is fired. |

### GAMEPLAY-03 — Wrong answer immediately restarts level (no partial credit)

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | User in M-13, on question 7 of 10 (any level). |
| **Action** | Select a wrong answer. |
| **Expected** | M-15 (Level fail) is displayed immediately. No further questions in the current attempt are shown. No correct answers are revealed. "Try again" restarts the level from Q1 with a fresh question set. Analytics event `level_failed` is fired. |

### GAMEPLAY-04 — Timer expiry is treated as a fail

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | User on M-13, mid-level; timer runs out without submitting an answer. |
| **Action** | Let the countdown hit zero. |
| **Expected** | M-16 (Timer expired) is displayed. Treated identically to wrong answer: restart with fresh question set. Analytics event `timer_expired` is fired. |

### GAMEPLAY-05 — Timer shortens on higher-difficulty levels

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Admin has configured a shorter timer for a high-difficulty level (e.g. level 50) vs. level 1 in A-07. |
| **Action** | Play level 1 and observe timer. Play level 50 and observe timer. |
| **Expected** | The countdown duration on level 50 is measurably shorter than on level 1. Timer value matches what is configured in admin A-07. |

### GAMEPLAY-06 — Timer warning colors trigger at correct thresholds

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | User in M-13. |
| **Action** | Let timer count down to ≤ 10 seconds, then ≤ 5 seconds. |
| **Expected** | Timer text color changes to `color-timer-warning` (`#E07B1A`) at ≤ 10s and `color-timer-critical` (`#C93A2E`) at ≤ 5s (per design-spec §7). |

### GAMEPLAY-07 — Question sets vary across attempts on same level

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | User fails level 3. |
| **Action** | Note the questions displayed. Attempt level 3 again. |
| **Expected** | The second attempt presents a different ordering or different subset of questions drawn from the level pool (per requirements.json: "question sets vary each attempt"). |

### GAMEPLAY-08 — Tapping a locked level node triggers IAP prompt

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | User without IAP purchase on M-11. |
| **Action** | Tap level 15 (locked). |
| **Expected** | M-22 (IAP unlock screen) is shown. |

### GAMEPLAY-09 — Level map remembers progress across sessions

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | User has completed 7 levels. Force-quit and relaunch the app. |
| **Action** | Navigate to M-11. |
| **Expected** | All 7 completed levels remain marked as completed. Current level (8) is highlighted. No progress is lost. |

### GAMEPLAY-10 — Network drop mid-level in main mode

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | User playing main/ranked mode on M-13; internet connection drops mid-game. |
| **Action** | Continue answering questions with no internet. |
| **Expected** | A banner appears: "Connection lost — your score won't be submitted." The level can be completed locally. Score submission is deferred to next online moment. App does not crash. |

### GAMEPLAY-11 — Level attempt includes launch-ready mixed question variant types

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Level pool has text_qa and verse_clue questions (image_clue may also exist if assets are ready). |
| **Action** | Start a level; play through all 10 questions. |
| **Expected** | Attempt includes ≥2 variant types and ≥1 non-text_qa question. All use 4-option MC UI (no free-text). `question_answered` events carry correct `question_type`. Launch is not blocked if no image_clue assets exist. |

## 5. IAP — In-App Purchase Unlock

> Source: `qa.mustNotBreak` ("IAP unlock after level 5"), design-spec.md §§1E, §20 (M-22–M-25), Flow 4, `product.monetization`.

### IAP-01 — IAP unlock triggered after completing level 5

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | User has no purchase; completes level 5 for the first time. |
| **Action** | Level 5 completes; "Next level" CTA appears on M-14. |
| **Expected** | Tapping "Next level" shows M-22 because level 6 is locked. Price displays as **₹49** (from store tier). |

### IAP-02 — Successful IAP purchase unlocks levels 6–100

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | User on M-22 with valid payment method. |
| **Action** | Tap "Unlock now" → complete system IAP sheet. |
| **Expected** | M-23 shown. Levels 6–100 unlock on M-11. Purchase persisted server-side. `purchase_completed` fired. |

### IAP-03 — User cancels IAP

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | User on M-22. |
| **Action** | Tap "Maybe later" or cancel the system IAP sheet. |
| **Expected** | App returns to M-11. Levels 6–100 remain locked. No charge occurs. |

### IAP-04 — IAP fails (payment error)

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | User on M-22; simulate a payment failure. |
| **Action** | Proceed through the system IAP sheet; payment is declined or fails. |
| **Expected** | M-24 (Purchase failed) is shown with "Try again" and "Contact support" options. No levels are unlocked. No duplicate charge occurs. |

### IAP-05 — Restore purchase on reinstall

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | User previously purchased; reinstalls app and signs in (same Apple ID / Google account). |
| **Action** | Navigate to M-27 (Settings) → "Restore purchase." |
| **Expected** | System restore call triggers. Levels 6–100 unlocked without new charge. M-25 shows success. |

### IAP-06 — Duplicate purchase prevention

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | User already has a valid purchase record on the server. |
| **Action** | Navigate to M-22 (e.g., via a locked level tap) and attempt to purchase again. |
| **Expected** | App detects existing purchase → auto-triggers a restore call and shows "You've already purchased this! Restoring your access…" without presenting the payment sheet. No second charge is initiated. |

### IAP-07 — IAP store unavailable

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | App Store / Play Store billing is unavailable (simulate). |
| **Action** | User navigates to M-22 and taps "Unlock now." |
| **Expected** | M-22 shows: "The store is unavailable right now. [Try again later]." Price area shows loading indicator before failing gracefully. App does not crash. |

## 6. ADS — Ad Display Rules (13+ Only, Frequency-Capped)

> Source: design-spec.md §20, M-21. Under-13 users see **no ads**. Practice mode always ad-free.

### ADS-01 — Under-13 user never sees M-21 ad break 🛡

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Consented under-13 user (age 10) in main/ranked mode. |
| **Action** | Complete levels 1–10 in main mode. |
| **Expected** | M-21 never displayed. No ad SDK initialization. No `ad_viewed` events. Flow proceeds M-14 → map/IAP directly. |

### ADS-02 — 13+ user sees ad on every 3rd level complete (after level 3)

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Adult user (age ≥ 13) in main/ranked mode. |
| **Action** | Complete levels 1–6 sequentially. |
| **Expected** | No ad after levels 1–3 (onboarding grace). Ad eligible after levels 3, 6 (every 3rd complete). M-21 may display when eligible. |

### ADS-03 — 13+ session cap: max 2 interstitials per session

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Adult user; fresh session. |
| **Action** | Complete 12 levels in one session (would trigger ads at 3, 6, 9, 12). |
| **Expected** | At most **2** M-21 ad impressions in the session. Third+ eligible slots silently skip ads. |

### ADS-04 — Ads do NOT appear in practice mode

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Any user in practice mode (M-18 / M-19). |
| **Action** | Play through a level in practice mode. |
| **Expected** | No ad units are displayed at any point during practice gameplay or result screens. |

### ADS-05 — Ad no-fill silently skips M-21 (max 2s wait)

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Simulate AdMob no-fill or SDK timeout in main/ranked mode. |
| **Action** | Complete a level and reach M-21 placement. |
| **Expected** | M-21 skipped within 2 seconds. User proceeds to next level or map without blank screen or crash. No `ad_viewed` event if no impression occurred. |

### ADS-06 — Ad click fires analytics event

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Adult user; ad displayed in main mode. |
| **Action** | Tap the ad. |
| **Expected** | Analytics event `ad_clicked` is fired. Ad interaction is handled by the AdMob SDK; app does not crash or navigate to an unintended screen. |

## 7. LEADERBOARD — Anti-Cheat, Submit & Sync

> Source: `qa.mustNotBreak` ("server-validated leaderboard attempts"), design-spec.md §§1F, §21, Flow 5.

### LEADERBOARD-01 — Leaderboard entry created only after server-validated completion

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | User online; completes level in main/ranked mode via normal gameplay. |
| **Action** | Complete 10/10 with per-answer API calls. |
| **Expected** | Server creates `LeaderboardEntry` on 10th validated correct answer. `leaderboard_submitted` fires. Score matches server-computed value on M-14. |

### LEADERBOARD-02 — Direct score POST rejected (anti-cheat)

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Authenticated user with API access. |
| **Action** | Call any legacy/direct leaderboard write endpoint with fabricated `{ score: 99999, level_id: 50 }`. |
| **Expected** | HTTP 404 or 403 — no such client-facing write route. Leaderboard unchanged. |

### LEADERBOARD-03 — Out-of-sequence answer rejected

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Active `LevelAttempt` on question index 2. |
| **Action** | POST answer for `question_index = 5` (skipping 2–4). |
| **Expected** | HTTP 400; attempt marked `failed` or `invalid`. No leaderboard entry. |

### LEADERBOARD-04 — Instant-answer bot timing rejected

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Active attempt. |
| **Action** | POST correct answer with `client_time_taken_ms = 50` (< 800ms floor). |
| **Expected** | Answer rejected; attempt flagged `suspicious`. No leaderboard entry. `leaderboard_attempt_rejected` analytics event. |

### LEADERBOARD-05 — Wrong answer ends attempt server-side

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Active attempt on question 4. |
| **Action** | POST incorrect `selected_option_index`. |
| **Expected** | Attempt `status = failed`. Subsequent answer POSTs rejected. No partial leaderboard credit. |

### LEADERBOARD-06 — Leaderboard refreshes periodically

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | User on M-17 (Leaderboard) with internet. |
| **Action** | Wait for the next scheduled poll (a few minutes). |
| **Expected** | Leaderboard data updates. The "Updated X min ago" badge reflects the latest refresh time. Analytics event `leaderboard_viewed` is not spammed — only fired on explicit navigation. |

### LEADERBOARD-07 — Leaderboard shows offline state gracefully

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | User navigates to M-17 with no internet connection. |
| **Action** | Open leaderboard tab. |
| **Expected** | Offline state UI is shown: illustration + "Leaderboard needs internet. Connect to see rankings." [Retry] button. App does not crash. "Your rank" pinned card is shown with cached data if available. |

### LEADERBOARD-08 — Deferred validation when offline during level

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | User starts ranked attempt online; loses connection mid-level after 5 validated answers. |
| **Action** | Complete remaining answers offline (queued); reconnect. |
| **Expected** | Queued answers submitted in order on reconnect. Server validates within `expires_at`. Leaderboard updated if valid; rejected if expired or suspicious. |

## 8. PRACTICE — Offline Practice Mode & Content Sync

> Source: `qa.mustNotBreak` ("offline practice mode"), design-spec.md §§1G, §19, Flow 6, `backend.contentSync`.

### PRACTICE-01 — Practice mode playable offline with valid local pack

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Device in airplane mode; valid Practice Content Pack on device (seed or prior download). |
| **Action** | Tap Practice tab → M-18. Select a level. Play through questions on M-19. |
| **Expected** | All gameplay functions normally. **No question API calls** during M-19. Timer and wrong-answer rules apply. Analytics `practice_mode_started` queues for later sync if offline. |

### PRACTICE-02 — Practice mode does not show ads

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Any user; device offline or online; practice mode. |
| **Action** | Complete a level in practice mode. |
| **Expected** | No ad units displayed at any point. M-21 never appears. |

### PRACTICE-03 — Practice mode does not prompt IAP

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | User without IAP; selecting a level > 10 in practice mode. |
| **Action** | Tap level 50 in M-18. |
| **Expected** | Level is playable without an IAP prompt. All 100 levels accessible per IA-08. |

### PRACTICE-04 — Practice mode does not submit to leaderboard

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | User completes a level in practice mode. |
| **Action** | Observe M-20 result screen and leaderboard. |
| **Expected** | No score submission. Leaderboard rankings unchanged. |

### PRACTICE-05 — First install offline with no local pack is blocked gracefully

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Fresh install; never online; no seed pack (simulate corrupt/missing seed). |
| **Action** | Open Practice tab M-18. |
| **Expected** | Blocked state: "Practice questions need a one-time download. Connect to the internet…" with Retry. App does not crash or show blank M-19. |

### PRACTICE-06 — Online launch detects stale cache and background-downloads new pack

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Device has local pack at `content_version = 5`. Server published `content_version = 6`. Device online. |
| **Action** | Cold-launch app (manifest check runs automatically). |
| **Expected** | `GET /v1/content/manifest` returns v6. Background download of practice-pack starts. Launch is **not** blocked. Main mode remains usable immediately. |

### PRACTICE-07 — Practice hub shows update banner while download in progress

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Stale cache; background download running (PRACTICE-06). |
| **Action** | Navigate to M-18 while download in progress. |
| **Expected** | Non-blocking banner: "Updating practice questions…" User can start a level on **old** pack. No gameplay interruption. |

### PRACTICE-08 — Atomic cache swap after successful download

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Background download completes; checksum matches manifest. |
| **Action** | Complete or start a new practice level after swap. |
| **Expected** | M-19 serves questions from v6 pack. `local_content_version` updated to 6. Analytics `content_cache_updated` fired. Banner on M-18 shows "Questions updated [date]" (dismissible). |

### PRACTICE-09 — Download failure keeps stale pack playable

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Stale cache; simulate practice-pack download failure (network drop or 500). |
| **Action** | Open M-18 and play a level. |
| **Expected** | Toast: "Couldn't update practice questions. Using saved questions." Practice playable on existing cache. Analytics `content_cache_update_failed` fired. |

### PRACTICE-10 — Offline play uses stale pack without error

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | User practiced offline for days; local pack is several versions behind server. |
| **Action** | Play practice levels while offline. |
| **Expected** | Stale questions play normally. No crash. Freshness banner hidden until online. |

### PRACTICE-11 — Main mode uses live server questions after admin publish

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Admin publishes content change (new question text for level 3). User has stale practice cache. Device online. |
| **Action** | Play level 3 in **main mode** (M-13) without waiting for practice pack download. |
| **Expected** | Main mode shows **updated** question text from server API. Practice cache staleness does not affect main mode. |

### PRACTICE-12 — Practice gameplay never calls live question API

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Device online; user in M-19 practice gameplay. |
| **Action** | Monitor network traffic during full level attempt. |
| **Expected** | No calls to `/v1/game/levels/*/questions` or equivalent. Only local pack reads. Manifest/download may occur in background on other screens. |

### PRACTICE-13 — Admin publish increments content_version

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Admin on A-07; current `content_version = 10`. |
| **Action** | Edit an approved question; click **Publish content**. |
| **Expected** | `ContentPublishRecord` created with `content_version = 11`. Mobile manifest returns 11 on next check. Draft-only saves do **not** increment version. |

### PRACTICE-14 — Checksum mismatch rejects corrupt download

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Simulate practice-pack response with checksum mismatch. |
| **Action** | Allow background download to complete. |
| **Expected** | New pack discarded. Old pack remains active. `content_cache_update_failed` logged. User notified via toast. |

## 9. ACCOUNT — Deletion, Data Removal & Sign-Out

> Source: `qa.mustNotBreak` ("in-app account deletion"), `security.accountDeletion`, `security.retentionPolicy`, design-spec.md §9 (M-29a–c).

### ACCOUNT-01 — Full account deletion flow (adult user)

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Logged-in adult user on M-26 (Profile). |
| **Action** | Tap "Delete my account" → M-29a. Tap "Delete account." Read M-29b. Tick the required checkbox. Tap "Confirm deletion." |
| **Expected** | M-29c confirms deletion. App returns to M-03 (Welcome). Backend deletes/anonymizes personal data immediately: mobile, name, age linkage, progress, leaderboard display name, and VPC record. Legally required purchase/audit records may remain only without PII linkage. |

### ACCOUNT-02 — Account deletion removes data immediately (retention policy) 🛡

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | User deleted per ACCOUNT-01. |
| **Action** | Query the database directly (or via admin A-09) for the deleted user record. |
| **Expected** | User record and PII are not retrievable from user/progress/leaderboard tables. Audit log contains a deletion event with timestamp but no PII. Purchase/audit records, if legally retained, use anonymized linkage only. |

### ACCOUNT-02A — Legally required records retained without PII 🛡

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | User with IAP purchase deletes account. |
| **Action** | Query retained purchase/audit records after deletion. |
| **Expected** | Required transaction/audit records remain only with anonymized user linkage. Mobile number, display name, child age linkage, and VPC parent fields are not retrievable. |

### ACCOUNT-03 — Account deletion of under-13 user removes data and parental consent record 🛡

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Under-13 user account with parental consent record. |
| **Action** | Complete deletion flow per ACCOUNT-01. |
| **Expected** | Parental consent record is also deleted. M-29a shows the additional note: "Your child's data will be permanently removed from our servers immediately." Audit log entry is created. |

### ACCOUNT-04 — Cancellation at each step of deletion flow

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Logged-in user on M-26. |
| **Action** | Start the deletion flow. Tap "Cancel" on M-29a. Repeat: start again, reach M-29b, tap "Cancel." |
| **Expected** | Each "Cancel" returns the user to M-26. No data is deleted. Account remains active. |

### ACCOUNT-05 — "Confirm deletion" button disabled until checkbox is ticked

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | User on M-29b (final confirmation). |
| **Action** | Observe "Confirm deletion" button state before ticking checkbox. |
| **Expected** | Button is disabled (greyed out or visually inactive) and non-tappable until the checkbox is checked. |

### ACCOUNT-06 — Sign-out confirmation

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Logged-in user accesses M-30 (Sign-out confirmation). |
| **Action** | Confirm sign-out. |
| **Expected** | Session is terminated. App returns to M-03 (Welcome). Account is not deleted — only the local session is ended. |

|---|---|

|---|---|

|---|---|

|---|---|

| **Action** | Filter by event type "account_deletion" for a recently deleted under-13 user. |
| **Expected** | A log entry exists for the deletion event with a timestamp, user reference, and event type. The entry is immutable (no edit/delete UI present on A-12). |

### ADMIN-08 — Admin-initiated user account deletion

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Admin on A-09 (User detail). |
| **Action** | Use the admin-initiated deletion trigger for a user account. |
| **Expected** | User PII is deleted/anonymized per `security.retentionPolicy`. An audit trail entry is created. The user can no longer sign in. |

### ADMIN-09 — Reports timezone handling

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | Admin on A-10 (Reports & analytics). |
| **Action** | View a report with daily breakdowns. |
| **Expected** | All timestamps are displayed in UTC with a timezone label, as required by `backend.timezoneHandling`. |

### ADMIN-11 — Publish content custom action increments content_version

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | AdminJS Level resource; current `content_version = 10`. |
| **Action** | Run **Publish content** custom action. |
| **Expected** | `ContentPublishRecord` at version 11. Mobile manifest returns 11. (See PRACTICE-13.) |

### ADMIN-12 — Invalidate suspicious leaderboard attempt (custom action)

| | |
|---|---|
| **Setup** | AdminJS; flagged `LevelAttempt` with leaderboard entry. |
| **Action** | Run **Invalidate attempt** action. |
| **Expected** | Attempt `status = invalid`. Leaderboard entry removed. Audit log entry created. |

## Risks & Assumptions

1. **VPC legal sufficiency (OQ-04):** v1 implements Path A (parent OAuth + attestation) and Path B (email plus confirmation) per design-spec §11. Counsel must confirm these methods satisfy COPPA for Anointed's third-party stack (AdMob, Firebase) before US launch. Tests VPC-01–VPC-16 assume this spec.

2. **Content publish cadence:** PRACTICE-06–PRACTICE-14 assume admin **Publish content** workflow (§19). Draft edits must not trigger client updates until publish.

3. **Timer configuration per level:** GAMEPLAY-05 assumes admin A-07 is the authoritative source for timer values. If timer values are hardcoded, the test must be adapted to verify the hardcoded mapping.

4. **Phone-only account recovery weakness:** AUTH-11 accepts the v1 tradeoff — phone users on new devices rely on mobile + name match or support. No SMS OTP exists. QA should document known limitation.

5. **Privacy Policy and Terms of Service not yet drafted:** AUTH-13 and ACCOUNT-01 assume these documents are live. `product.legalDocs` marks both as "needs drafting" — store submission and VPC forms are blocked until these exist.

6. **Ad policy v1:** Under-13 ad-free; 13+ frequency caps in ADS-02–ADS-03. Do not expect meaningful ad revenue — IAP is primary.

7. **Question variety:** GAMEPLAY-11 requires all three variant types authored in test level pools per §18H.
